rules.statement: An interlocutory order in a Partition Act case is not a judgment, but an order with a final expression of the decision, and thus requires leave to appeal.
rules.supporting_quote: It is to be noted that the question arises whether the Interlocutory Order of the learned Judge of the District Court of Ratnapura falls under Section 754(1) or 754(2) of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 754(1) of the Civil Procedure Code, Section 754(2) of the Civil Procedure Code, Section 754(5) of the Civil Procedure Code
